provisioningEnabled.description: Installation-time provider-networking setting. When connected to Fulfillment, the Operator verifies it matches the saved value before reconciliation.

namespace.description: Namespace the osac-observability chart renders into. The operator issues the write-path client certificates here.

infrastructure.description: Scrape interval the operator writes into each tenant cluster's monitoring configuration.

enabled.description: Configures every tenant cluster to remote-write through the managed proxy. Requires the osac-observability write path.

writeCAIssuer.description: Name of the ready cert-manager Issuer that signs tenant client certificates.

revocationConfigMap.description: Name of the shared denylist of withdrawn certificate serials the write proxy reads.

routeName.description: Name of the Route, Service and Deployment that serve the write proxy.

certificateDuration.description: Lifetime of an issued tenant client certificate.

renewBefore.description: How long before expiry cert-manager renews a tenant client certificate.

dropRule.description: One drop-rule definition shared by the proxy and the cluster-side copy.

keepKubePrefix.description: The only kube_ metric family a tenant cluster may send.

dropPrefixes.description: Metric-name prefixes a tenant cluster drops before sending.
